tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ni gu ma'i rnam thar bzhugs so// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos sku nam mkha' lta bu'i rang bzhin las/ /gzugs sku nyi zla lta bu'i 'od zer gyis/ /gdul bya blo yi mun pa sel mdzad pa/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas 'dud/ /de la 'dir ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ni gu ma'i rnam thar zur tsam gcig brjod na/ sku 'khrungs pa'i yul ni/ grong khyer chen po dpe med ces bya ba kha che'i sa na yod pa yin/ yul de yang sgyu ma mkhan gyis sprul pa'i grong khyer yin no/ /ji ltar sprul na/ sngon rgyal po 'od srung bzhugs pa'i dus na/ dgra bcom pa nyi ma'i gung pa zhes bya ba yod pas/ dus de tsam na sa phyogs de thams cad mtsho ru mer song nas yod pa la/ dgra bcom pa des yul phyogs der gtsug lag khang gcig bzhengs par 'dod pas/ klu'i rgyal po la sa bslangs pas/ klu rnams na re/ khyod rang gi skyil krung gis khyab pa'i sa sbyin no zhes khas blangs so/ /der dgra bcom pa des sku shin tu che ba gcig sprul nas kha che'i sa phyogs de khyab par byas te der sa gzhi byung nas/ bdud rtsi gha gha'i gtsug lag khang bya ba gcig bzhengs so/ /der mi rnams ngo mtshar skyed pa'i phyir du sgyu ma mkhan gcig bos nas/ des grong khyer chen po dpe med ces bya ba grong khyer chen po lta na sdug pa la dpe blangs te sprul pas/ sgyu ma ma bshig pa'i 'og tu sgyu ma mkhan de bsad pas/ de da ltar gyi bar du chags so/ /grong khyer de yang 'dzam bu'i gling na de lta bu'i dpe med zer ba byung bas dpe med du grags so/ /de na chang tshong ma rang yang grong khyer 'bum tsho so drug yod do/ /de'i bye brag pu na zhes bya ba yin no/ /grong khyer ba'i paṇ+ṭi ta nā ro pa dang / rin chen rdo rje gnyis bzhugs so/ /ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ni gu ma'i yab ni bram ze chen po zhi ba'i go cha/

yum ni bram ze mo dpal gyi blo gros gnyis kyi sras mor 'khrungs/ mtshan gzhi dpal gyi ye shes/ nā ro paṇ+ḍi ta'i lcam mo yin/ rigs ni bram ze'o/ /bskal pa grangs med pa gsum gyi sngon rol nas/ lam sbyangs pa sngon du gyur pa'i rgyun lam gyis skye ba de nyid la bla ma grub thob 'ga' re'i gdams ngag gsungs sgros re tsam thos pa la rten nas chos nyid bden pa mngon sum du mthong / zag bcas kyi rgyu lus zag med lha'i sku ru rang shar te/ dag pa sa gsum la gnas pa'i rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid dang zhal mngon sum du mjal te/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob nas/ mdo rgyud man ngag bstan bcos la sogs pa'i chos kyi sgo thams cad la mkhyen pa'i ye shes sangs rgyas ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i chos rnams mngon du gyur te/ sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' nyid du gyur te/ shes bya'i sgrib pa phra zhing phra ba gcig las spang bya med par/ sangs rgyas dang gnyis su med cing sku gsum gyi bdud rtsi can/ rang don spang rtogs mthar phyin nas/ gzhan don gzugs sku gnyis kyis ji srid 'khor ba ma stong gyi bar du/ gang la gang 'dul gyis 'gro don mdzad cing / khyad par du rgyud pa 'dzin pa rnams la thugs rje nye ring med par gzigs nas byin gyis rlobs cing / 'phrin las mthar phyin par thugs rjes gzigs pa nyid do/ /yang sgos su grub thob chen po khyung po rnal 'byor pa de nyid la sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi rdzogs su bskur nas/ rgyud man ngag bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bka' lung gnang zhing khyad par du snod ldan gyi gang zag rnams tshe gcig lus gcig la rtogs pa mngon gyur gyi sangs rgyas la 'god par nus pa'i gdams pa'i gnad zab la rgya che ba mang po gnang nas/ mi rab bdun du chig brgyud las mi spel bar bka' rgyas btab cing /

slob ma brgyud 'dzin dang bcas pa thams cad dag pa mkha' spyod du 'gro bar lung bstan pas na/ brgyud pa gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa nyid do/ /thog mar byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ /dran pa bzhi dang yang dag spong ba bzhi/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang bzhi'i don la legs gnas pas/ /tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi mthun zil gnon dad sogs dbang po lnga/ /shes rab la sogs stobs mchog lnga ldan pas/ /gzung 'dzin dgra'i dpung las rnam rgyal zhing / /chos rgyun ting 'dzin sbyor la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten chos kyi mchog gi rjes thog tu/ /byang chub yan lag bdun du bstan pa'i don/ /chos kyi klong dang brjod du med pa'i dbyings/ /bden pa mngon sum gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag lta ba'i don la ma g.yengs par/ /rim pa dgu'i bar du nyams bstan pas/ /'du shes gnyis kyis mi dbye ba yi don/ /bsgom pa mngon du gyur la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khams gsum sa dgu'i mi mthun pa yi phyogs/ /mthong spang brgya dang bcu gnyis gang bstan dang / /sgom spangs bzhi brgya bcu gnyis la sogs pas/ /nyon mongs sgrib pa dag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgyu ma tsam du 'dzin pa'i sgrib pa'am/ /shes bya'i sgrib pa phra zhing phra ba kun/ /'od gsal rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin des/ /mngon du gyur pas 'dzoms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor gsum yongs dag sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin/ /chos dbyings kun 'gro khyab pa'i don rtogs pas/ /snyoms 'jug mthong dang byin rlabs la sogs pa/ /brgya phrag bcu gnyis thob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdung ba zhi ba'i tshul khrims pha rol phyin/ /chos dbyings rang shar mchog gi don rtogs pas/ /yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis la sogs pa/ /stong phrag bcu gnyis thob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khro ba mi mnga' bzod pa'i pha rol phyin/ /chos kyi dbyings su rgyu mthun don rtogs pa'i/ /yon tan sangs rgyas brgya stong phrag bcu gnyis/

/mngon par thob pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge bas mi ngoms brtson 'grus pha rol phyin/ /chos dbyings yongs su 'dzin de don rtogs pas/ /ting 'dzin phrag khrig phrag khrig phrag gnyis so/ /kun nas mnyes pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes g.yo med bsam gtan pha rol phyin/ /dbyings dang rgyud gzhan tha dad med rtogs pas/ /yon tan phrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcu gnyis/ /mngon du gyur pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma skyes che shos shes rab pha rol phyin/ /dbyings dang rnam byang nyon mongs dbyer med rtogs/ /phrag khrig brgya stong phrag khrig brgya stong phrag /bcu gnyis mnyes pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes sgrub pa'i thabs kyi pha rol phyin/ /dbyings dang mtshan nyid tha dad med par rtogs/ ting nge 'dzin /yon tan bye ba phrag khrig brgya stong rnams/ /kun nas mnyes pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog la dmigs nas smon lam pha rol phyin/ /'phel 'grib med dbyings dag pa'i don rtogs pas/ /stong gsum brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul snyed gnyis/ /snyoms par 'jug sogs thob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdud dpung bcom phyir stobs kyi pha rol phyin/ /spobs pa thogs med ye shes dbang don rtogs/ /sangs rgyas zhing grangs med pa'i rdul snyed la/ /brgya stong snyoms 'jug thob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji bzhin rtogs pa ye shes pha rol phyin/ /chos dbyings sgrib med snyam rjes blo dang bral/ /gang stong 'phel 'grib med pa'i ngang gnas pa'i/ /'phrin las dag pa'i don rtogs phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal sras sa bcu'i dbang phyug de nyid ni/ /stong gsum mkha' la seng ge'i khri steng bzhag /'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur mdzad pa yis/ /shes bya'i sgrib pa dag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nang ltar 'og min btsun mo'i gzhal yas su/ /zag med bde ba chen po'i dbang bskur bas/ /skad cig de la chos dbyings snang ba yis/ /mkhyen pa phyogs med rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/

/'dus ma byas pa'i don dam chos dbyings dang / /mkhyen brtse'i ye shes gnyis su med pa yis/ /bsten dang bsags dang khyab dang rang bzhin grub/ /chos kun mngon du gyur la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos kyi sku la bzhengs bzhugs mi mnga' yang / /sngon gyi bsod nams sems bskyed la sogs pas/ /gzugs sku rnam gnyis rang shar byung nas kyang / /'khor ba stong par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med bde ba'i sku/ /bde gshegs sprul pa thun mong mchog gi bdag /sa bcu'i dbang phyug 'khor ba 'dren pa'i dpal/ /rus pa'i rgyan can de la gsol ba 'debs/ /'gro ba drug gi ma rgan sems can rnams/ /gting mtha' med par 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho nas/ /zag med bde ba rgyas pa'i zhing khams su/ /thugs rjes dmigs med ngang nas drangs du gsol/ /lam du bzhugs pa'i skal ldan pho mo kun/ /'gal rkyen gegs dang bar chad kun zhi ste/ /nyams dang rtogs pa gong du 'phel ba dang / /lam lnga sa bcu bgrod par byin gyis rlobs/ /a nan ta yi rtogs pa'i klong dkyil nas/ dmigs med snying rje thogs med shar ba yi/ /ji srid 'khor bar sems can gnas kyi bar/ /'gro ba'i bran bzhin byed par byin gyis rlobs/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i rnam par zur tsam 'di/ /brgyud 'dzin rnams kyi rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /ku su pa yi sprang po rmog lcog pas/ /dgyes rdor yang dgon dpal gyi dgon par sbyar/ /dge ba 'di yis brgyud 'dzin gang zag rnams/ /bla ma'i rnam par tshul bzhin skyong bar shog /'di bris dge ba'i rnam smin gyis/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can rnams/ /bla med sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ni gu ma'i rnam par thar pa rgya mtsho las/ /skra rtser bzung ba'i thigs pa tsam cung zad bsdus pa 'di/ brgyud 'dzin dad pa can rnams dad pa skye ba'i phyir dang / phyis the tshom can rnams the tshom las grol bar bya ba dang /

log lta can rnams dge ba la bskul ba'i phyir du/ mkhyen rab dang thugs rje tshad med pa mnga' ba rmog lcog pa zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa de nyid kyis bsdebs pa'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ// //shubhaṃ// //dge'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 ngag dbang chos grags pa/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma ni gu ma'i rnam thar/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
